verses.text: Ix meltzajkot jun ángel ix lolon chi' wet'ok, ix xib'tanel in wayanh, icha yel lenaj swayanh junok mach waynakb'ati. Ix sk'anb'an t'ayin icha tik:

¿Tas tzila'? xchi t'ayin. Ix walan t'ay: Swil jun b'akhnub' kandil nab'a oro yet' jun yet'tal akeite ayk'e t'a yib'anh. Ha t'a jun b'akhnub' chi', ayoch uke' kandil. Junjun kandil chi' ay stuboal tz'ik'an b'ey akeite chi'.
Junnhej ay chab' te' oliwo yet' jun b'akhnub' kandil chi', jun te' ayoch t'a swach', aypaxoch junxo te' t'a sk'exanh, xin chi t'ay.
Ix in k'anb'an pax t'ay icha tik: Mamin, ¿tas wal syalelk'och jun tik? xin chi t'ay.
Ix yalan t'ayin: ¿Tom manh ojtakok tas syalelk'ochi? xchi t'ayin. Ix walani: Maay mamin, xin chi t'ay.
Ix yalanxi jun ángel chi' t'ayin icha tik: Haton jun lolonel tik syal Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil t'a winhaj Zorobabel: Manh yujok heb' soldado, manh yujok pax ipalil, palta a yuj Wespíritu ol yal uuj.

Ach Zorobabel, wach'chom te ajaltak sb'o in templo icha niwak witz, palta malaj ol och t'ayach. Ha ach ol ak'och k'een lajwub' k'een niwan yelk'ochi, yakb'an tz'el yaw masanil heb' chonhab' icha tik: Te wach' yilji. Ayokab' swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh, xcham heb', xchi Jehová, xchi jun ángel chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
Ha winhaj Zorobabel ix ak'anem yich jun templo tik, hanheja' winh ol lajanpaxok. Ichato chi', ol nachajel yuj in chonhab' to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil ix ach in chekb'at ala'.

Ha juntzanh heb' tz'alani to malaj swach'il jun templo ayik ex el yich sb'oi, ayik ol yilanoch heb' to wan yak'anoch plomo winhaj Zorobabel t'a k'een lajwub' k'een, ol tzalajk'e heb', xchi Jehová. Ixlajwi juntzanh tik, ix yalan jun ángel chi' icha tik: Ha uke' kandil tik, haton sch'oxankot yol sat Jehová, to syil t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi t'ayin.
Ix in k'anb'anxi t'ay: ¿Tas pax syalelk'och chab' te' oliwo chi', junjun te' t'a stz'eytak jun b'akhnub' kandil chi'? xin chi t'ay.
Ix in k'anb'anpaxi: ¿Tas syalelk'och chab' sk'ab' te' oliwo junnhej yaj yet' chab' tubo nab'a oro b'aj tz'em akeite chi'? xin chi.
Ix tak'wi jun ángel chi' t'ayin icha tik: ¿Tom manh ojtakok tas syalelk'ochi? xchi t'ayin. Maay mamin, manh wojtakoklaj, xin chi.
Ix yalan t'ayin: Haton chab' sk'ab' tik sch'oxankot heb' chawanh sik'b'ileli, haton heb' tz'ak'an serwil Jehová, haton Yajal t'a Smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi jun ángel chi'.
